# browser

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/browser"
```

Package browser is the pick\-from\-a\-list screen: labels on the left, the selected item's detail on the right, tab to move focus between them. It owns only the browsing state; what a choice means is the caller's.

<a name="Action"></a>
## type [Action](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/browser/browser.go#L25>)

Action is what a key did.

```go
type Action int
```

<a name="None"></a>

```go
const (
    None      Action = iota
    Dismissed        // esc on the list: close without choosing
    Chosen           // enter on the list: the caller reads Selected
)
```

<a name="Item"></a>
## type [Item](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/browser/browser.go#L19-L22>)

Item is one row: what the list prints and what the preview shows for it. Detail is called on render, so an expensive body is only built when shown.

```go
type Item struct {
    Label  string
    Detail func() string
}
```

<a name="Keys"></a>
## type [Keys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/browser/browser.go#L34-L36>)

Keys are the bindings the browser answers to.

```go
type Keys struct {
    Up, Down, PageUp, PageDown, Enter, Esc, Tab key.Binding
}
```

```go
func (m Model) SetPreviewHeight(h int) Model
```

SetPreviewHeight tells the browser how tall its preview pane is, which is what a page is. Call it from the owner's relayout.
